Commentary.Commentary: We are back for Australia's reply! The players are out in the middle. Cameron Green will continue to open the batting alongside David Warner. Chris Woakes will begin with the new ball. A slip in place. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Now then, the English batters have done a terrific job and have set a massive target. But Australia have all the quality in their ranks to chase this one down. Let's see what we have in store for us in the second innings. Stay tuned!

England got off to a rollicking start thanks to their openers, Alex Hales and Jos Buttler. The duo started firing from the word go and took England to a score of 118 at the halfway stage. Jos Buttler perished soon after a blistering knock of 68 off just 32 balls. Alex Hales continued his merry way but could not hang around till the end. He was dismissed after a fiery knock of 84. A handy cameo from Chris Woakes in the final over made sure England got over the 200-mark. They will feel that they fell short of about 10 runs considering the start they got. But they have still managed to post a mammoth total.

It's been a satisfactory recovery from Australia! They have done a good job in the slog-overs after the smashing they received in the beginning. Aaron Finch's decision to bowl first certainly backfired here. All their bowlers were taken to the cleaners in the first half of the match, but they did decently well to pull things back their way a tad. They picked up wickets in a heap towards the end and took some sort of control. Nathan Ellis was definitely the pick of the bowlers, amidst all the carnage he grabbed three wickets and gave away only 20 runs.
A single to end the innings! It is a full-length ball, outside off. Woakes guides it to point and takes a single. England end their innings at 208/6.
SIX! THIS IS HUGE! It is a length ball, on off. Chris Woakes picks up the length really well. It makes a beautiful sound as it comes off the middle and smokes over the wide long on fence.
A wide yorker, this time. Chris Woakes tries to dab it away but misses it.
FOUR! What a shot! Chris Woakes gets his side over the 200-run mark. Back of a length, outside off. Chris Woakes stands tall and cuts it well over covers for a boundary.
Length ball, on middle and leg. Chris Woakes nudges it towards the gap at mid on. The batters are quick between the wickets and get a couple.
Short ball, on off. This is pulled to the leg side for a single.
Chris Woakes makes his way out in the middle. Kane Richardson will bowl the final over of the innings.

OUT! CAUGHT! Nathan Ellis picks up another wicket. He ends his spell of 4 with three wickets under his belly. It is a slower bumper, on off. Moeen Ali stands tall and tries to help it over the keeper's head, although he hardly has any pace to work with here. The ball lobs towards short third. Mitchell Marsh steps to his right and takes a dolly. No celebrations this time, as they need to get ready for the final over.
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Marsh b Nathan Ellis

Commentary.Commentary: Full length, wide outside off. Ali looks to chase it but misses.
Malan gets a single off his very first delivery. It is a length ball, around off. Malan guides it down to third man and takes one.
Dawid Malan comes to the crease.

OUT! TIMBER! Nathan Ellis picks up his second wicket. Follows the two dot balls with a wicket. A well deserved one. It is full-length ball, attacking the stumps. Sam Curran shuffles across a bit too much for the scoop but fails to get a clean connection. The ball goes through to disturb the stumps. A quick celebration by the Aussies as the timer is running down.
Two dots on the trot now! It is a short ball, outside off. Sam Curran shuffles across but ducks under it in the end. He is looking at the square leg umpire for a wide but it isn't given.
Full length, in the channel. Sam Curran looks to slog it away but misses it completely.

SIX! ALL THE WAY! A huge hit. Sams follows the batter with a full one down leg. Moeen Ali picks up the length early and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence with a good swing of the blade. The extra delivery makes it a costly over for Australia.
Nathan Ellis comes to bowl the penultimate over. 1 for 19 in his 3 overs so far.
WIDE! Sams needs to reload his final delivery now. This is spilles down leg. Curran lets it be. Wided.
Curran moves down leg and Sams follows him with a full one. Curran tucks it to mid-wicket for one more.
It is full, attacking the pads. Ali flicks it aerially over square leg and crosses for a single.
Sam Curran gets off the mark. It is fuller, down leg. Sam Curran goes back and flicks it towards mid-wicket. Only for one.
Sam Curran is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! England are losing wickets in a flurry in the death overs. It is a short ball, on off. Brook hangs back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. The ball hangs in the air for a while and Kane Richardson sets himself up brilliantly to gather it with both hands.
Commentary.Howout: c Kane Richardson b Daniel Sams

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, outside off, Brook shuffles across and tries to go for the scoop. He goes not get any bat on it.
TWO WIDES! A slower bouncer, on off. This one goes over the head of the batter. Wade fails to collect it as the ball dips. The batters sneak a single, while the umpire signals a wide.
FOUR! Good use of the feet here! It is fuller, outside off. Brook back up a bit and lofts it over backward point to find a boundary. This will surely spoil the over for Stoinis.
Touch fuller, at the stumps. Ali drives it through covers and crosses.
Another single now as this is pulled to deep mid-wicket this time by Brook. Again no pace on offer.
Short ball, on leg. Ali stays back and pulls it to deep square leg. One taken.
On the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for a single. Harry Brook slips as he charges towards the other end. He makes it in time though.

A dot to start with! It is a good-length ball, on middle. Harry Brook makes room and looks to slash it over the off side. The ball takes the outside edge but does not carry to the keeper, as it is an off-pace delivery.
It is full, down leg. Brook makes room and plays it through extra covers. They take a single now. A successful over from Kane Richardson comes to an end.
PLAY AND A MISS! Good length, in the channel. Brook tries to chase it but gets beaten.
FOUR! Top placement! It is a length ball, outside off. Harry Brook plays it a bit late and guides it through backward point for a boundary.
A single now as this is driven through covers.
Moeen Ali makes his way out in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Alex Hales misses out on his ton. He will be really disappointed with himself. Fraction short, on off. Alex Hales smacks it towards long off but straight into the hands of Tim David in the deep. This has been a good passage of play for Australia.
Commentary.Howout: c Tim David b Kane Richardson

Commentary.Commentary: A few questions being asked for the catch! The umpires converge and take it upstairs . The soft signal is not out. It is fuller in length, wide of off. Alex Hales dabs it towards backward point. The fielder there takes the catch and appeals for the catch. The replays later confirm that it is a bump ball and the on-field decision stands.
LEG BYE! A length ball, angled down leg. Hales looks to glance it away but misses. It rolls out to the leg side off his pads. They collect a leg bye.
Harry Brook gets off the mark instantly. It is fuller, on off. Brook fends it down to point and scampers across for a quick single.
Harry Brook walks out to bat at number 4.

OUT! CAUGHT! Marcus Stoinis has the last laugh here. It is full-length ball, on off, an off-pace delivery though. Ben Stokes dances down the track and lofts it towards long on. He does not get the desired distance on it and David Warner makes no mistake in the deep.
Commentary.Howout: c David Warner b Marcus Stoinis

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Streaky! Ben Stokes has the lady luck on his side. It is full, outside off. Ben Stokes makes room and looks to pull the trigger. The ball takes the outside edge and goes down to third man for a boundary.
Another single now, as Hales shuffles across and flicks it towards long on. The Barmy Army is getting louder and louder now.
Slower ball now, full and on off. Stokes pushes it gently towards mid off and crosses.
Marcus Stoinis comes back into the attack. He went for 21 runs in his first over.
So, 11 runs off the over! It is a yorker now, outside off. Alex Hales looks heave it down the track but connects with thin air.

FOUR! And again! Consecutive boundaries for Hales. It is a length ball, on off. Alex Hales whips it towards wide long on. David Warner runs to his right, puts in a dive to that side but in vain. Hales is finding the gaps really well here. Hales moves to 83.
FOUR! Up and over! Alex Hales continues to find boundaries at will. It is overpitched, on off. Alex Hales shuffles across and lofts it over mid off and bags a boundary.
A full toss now, straying on the pads. Ben Stokes flicks it to square leg for a single.
Slight halt! Ben Stokes has been hit on his helmet while trying to play a reverse-sweep shot. The physio is out there to conduct the mandatory concussion test.

OUCH! Ben Stokes is smacked on his grills here. It is a length ball, on off. Ben Stokes switches his stance and looks to play the reverse hit. Stokes does not get any connection on it. The ball rolls off his arms and hits him near his chin. Daniel Sams is the first one to go towards the batter and have a check on him.

IN THE AIR...DROPPED! A tough chance nonetheless. Kane Richardson does not time his jump well and it spills out off his hand. Full length, on off. Stokes comes down the track and lobs it over mid off. Kane Richardson back-pedals and tries to take a one-handed catch but his effort goes down in vain. The batters take a couple.
A dot to end the over then! Slower ball, around the middle and leg, on a length. Alex Hales misses his flick and gets hit near the groin area. ANother big over for England.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Full and outside off. Alex Hales waits for it and carves it over extra cover for a cracking boundary. Back-to-back fours for Hales!
FOUR! Alex Hales makes good use of the Free Hit! Another full toss, around middle. Alex Hales slogs this one uppishly towards cow corner for a boundary.
No ball! Oh, a nasty ball from Green! He misses his length here and serves a full toss, over the stumps. Alex Hales does well to get away from that one. No ball called. Free Hit is coming up!
Wide! Too short this time, around off. Alex Hales misses his pull. Wide called for height!
FOUR! He gets this one away now! On a length, width again. Alex Hales stays in his crease and cuts it over backward point for a boundary.
Play and a miss! Wide again, a fuller ball now. Alex Hales looks to go over cover but he misses.
Wide of off, yorker now. Alex Hales fails to squeeze this one away.
Tad fuller now, around middle. Ben Stokes pushes it towards the left of the bowler. Nathan Ellis makes a good stop.
Angling in, another length ball, darting it on the thigh pad, at around 133 clicks. Ben Stokes tucks it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Good-length delivery, around middle and leg. Alex Hales strokes it down to long on and rotates the strike.
Outside off, on a length. Ben Stokes rocks back and guides it down to third man for a single. He gets off the mark with that!
Ben Stokes comes in at number three.

OUT! TAKEN! A much, much-need wicket for the Aussies! They have finally managed to break this opening stand. An excellent knock from the skipper comes to an end. A length ball, around the leg pole. Jos Buttler makes room and looks to go over mid on. But he miscues his shot on the right of the fielder there. Kane Richardson runs across and takes a good catch. Nathan Ellis provides Australia with a breakthrough.
Commentary.Howout: c Kane Richardson b Nathan Ellis

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! It's raining boundaries! 15th four of the innings. A shortish ball, around middle. Jos Buttler swivels and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
On a length again, outside off. Jos Buttler steers it down to third man for a run.
Another length delivery, outside off. Alex Hales guides it down to third man and rotates the strike.
Wide yorker. Alex Hales fails to dig this one out.
EDGED AND FOUR AGAIN! Inside edge this time! Outside off, a length ball. Alex Hales looks to block this one but the ball goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for a boundary.
Takes the pace of this one, around middle and off, slightly short now. Alex Hales makes room and misses his cut.

FOUR! Streaky boundary! Everything is going England's way for now. A short ball, around middle. Alex Hales goes for the pull shot but the ball goes off the top edge over the keeper's head and towards fine leg for a boundary.

Drinks! England are off to a flying start! Alex Hales and Jos Buttler have been putting on quite a show here. If they continue to bat like that, a total of 250 will surely be on the cards. Australia are in desperate need of a wicket.
FOUR! Put away! Very short this time, around middle. Jos Buttler pulls it wide of long on for another boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Tight line this time. Alex Hales taps it towards point for a single.
Outside off, short in length. Jos Buttler slaps this one down to long off for a single.
SIX! UP AND AWAY! Short again, around middle. Jos Buttler goes deep in his crease and pulls it high over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Back of a length, around middle. Alex Hales steps down and works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Fifty for Alex Hales too! He brings it up with a boundary as well. Short ball, around middle and leg. Alex Hales uses the depth of his crease and pulls it powerfully towards deep square leg for a boundary. 29-ball 50 for Alex Hales! He is looking quite dangerous as well.
Angling in, around middle and leg, fuller ball. Alex Hales flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes a run.
A fuller ball, around middle. Jos Buttler shuffles across and scoops it toward fine leg. Only a single now. That brings up the 100 for England!

FOUR! This time he gets it away and brings up his fifty in style! Short and outside off. Jos Buttler leans back, opens the face of the bat and pushes it over short third man for a boundary. 50 in just 25 balls.

Another slower ball, short this time, outside off. Jos Buttler looks to uppercut this but he fails to get any bat on it. An appeal for caught behind but the umpire says no. Aaron Finch wanted to that one but he runs out of time. He asked the umpire weather that carried cleanly to Wade or not. He does not seem quite happy there.
Very full this time, slower one this time at 117 clicks, around off. Alex Hales knocks it down to long on and rotates the strike.
On a length, outside off, at 124.4 clicks. Jos Buttler drags it with the inner half of his bat towards long on for a single.
A fuller ball, around middle and leg, angling in. Jos Buttler works it away towards mid-wicket for a single. 21 runs off Marcus Stoinis' first over.
Another wide delivery, the length is short as well. Alex Hales puts it away towards deep cover. Only a single now.
Two more! Short and wide of off. Alex Hales cuts it towards sweeper cover for a brace.
SIX! Up and away! These two are putting up quite a show here! Fuller ball, around middle. Alex Hales thumps it straight down the ground for another maximum of the over.
Wide! Very short this time. No need for Alex Hales to duck for that one. Wide called for height!

EDGED AND SIX! 10 off the first 2 balls! A length ball, around the leg pole. Alex Hales swivels and looks to pull this one, but the ball goes off the top edge all the way towards fine leg for a biggie.
FOUR! Alex Hales greets Marcus Stoinis with a boundary now! Width on offer, shortish ball. Alex Hales cuts it over backward point for a boundary.
Marcus Stoinis is brought into the attack!
Mitchell Swepson drops it short again, around middle. Alex Hales miscues his pull towards long on for a single.
Quicker this time, short again, around middle. Alex Hales plays it back to the bowler.
Back of a length, around middle. Alex Hales rocks back and blocks it out.
Short ball now, around middle. Jos Buttler pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
SIX! Another one! This is Jos Buttler at his brutal best! Full again, around middle. Jos Buttler heaves this one well over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
SIX! BOOM! Jos Buttler welcomes Mitchell Swepson with a maximum! A fuller ball, loopy one, around middle. Jos Buttler dances down the track and smokes it straight down the ground for a maximum.
Slower ball, around middle and leg, a length ball. Jos Buttler flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single. England are 58 for 0 at the end of the Powerplay!
A low full toss, around middle. Alex Hales clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.

PUT DOWN! A terrific effort though from Mitchell Marsh! Pace off this time, outside off, a length ball. Jos Buttler shuffles across again and goes for the scoop. But the ball goes off the top edge towards short third man. Mitchell Marsh runs to his right, dives, sticks his right hand out, he gets to the ball but fails to t grab it. A single taken!
Shorter ball, around middle. Alex Hales pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
On a length, around middle. Alex Hales blocks it out.
FOUR! In the gap again! Outside off, a length ball. Alex Hales stays in his crease and just guides it in the gap between backward point and short third man for a boundary.
A fuller ball, around middle. Jos Buttler pushes it towards the fielder at mid on.

SIX! AND AGAIN! This time it goes all the way! Kane Richardson drops it short again, around off. Jos Buttler shuffles across and scoops it again well over the short fine leg for a biggie. 50 up for England!
FOUR! Oh, that's classical Jos Buttler! A fuller ball, around off. Jos Buttler shuffles across and scoops it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Tailing back in, on a length, around middle. Jos Buttler taps it towards mid-wicket with a closed-face bat. No run there!
Angling in now, a length ball, around middle and leg. Alex Hales clips it towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Up and just over! Shorter ball, down leg. Alex Hales makes room and cuts it just over the leaping fielder at point. The ball races away towards the boundary ropes for a four. Nicely done!
Swing and a miss! Pace on this time, fuller ball, outside off. Jos Buttler looks to go downtown but he fails to get any bat on it. Good over for Australia.
Back of a length, around middle and off. Alex Hales heaves this one towards the man at deep mid-wicket. The ball falls short of him though. Another single is taken.
Nathan Ellis takes the pace off this one, he serves it at around 118 clicks, shorter one, outside off. Jos Buttler miscues his pull towards square leg. Only a single.
On a length again, darting this around the thigh pad. Alex Hales works it away towards square leg and rotates the strike.
On a length, around middle and leg. Jos Buttler flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Nathan Ellis starts off with a slower one, full ball, on the pads. Alex Hales tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Jos Buttler uses the depth of his crease and pulls it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Well bowled! Daniel Sams goes 'round the wicket now, and delivers a length ball, outside off. Jos Buttler looks to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Daniel Sams takes the pace off this one, he serves a fuller ball, on the pads at around 117 clicks. Alex Hales works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! BANG! Daniel Sams goes fuller now, around off. Alex Hales makes room and thumps it over mid off all the way for a maximum.
Swing and a miss! Offers width now, a length ball. Alex Hales looks to cut this one but he fails to get any connection on that.
Daniel Sams starts off with a nasty short ball, on the body, pace on. Alex Hales fails to block this one and gets hit on his chest.
Daniel Sams comes into the attack.
Outside off, a length delivery. Jos Buttler cuts it to the fielder at backward point.
Leg bye! A length ball, nipping in, around middle. Alex Hales gets hit on his thigh pad while trying to tuck it away. The ball rolls towards backward point and the batters cross ends.
FOUR! Alex Hales is off the mark in fine fashion as well! Width on offer again, slightly short. Alex Hales stays in his crease and slashes it past point for a boundary.
Angling in now, another good-length delivery, around middle. Alex Hales gets an inside edge onto his pads while trying to flick this one.
On a length, outside off. Alex Hales cuts it to the fielder at point.
Kane Richardson begins with a length ball, angling away, wide of off. Alex Hales looks to cut this one but he misses.
Who will bowl from the other end? Kane Richardson it is!

FOUR! ANother boundary! Jos Buttler is on the charge straightaway! Fuller ball, outside off. Jos Buttler drives this one over mid off for the fourth boundary in the first over. 16 runs in the opening over.
Better from Green! Yorker now, around middle. Jos Buttler digs it out towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Three in a row now! This is a lovely start for England! Cameron Green sticks to bowling the full-length delivery, around middle. Jos Buttler tonks it straight down the ground for a boundary.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for Jos Buttler! Another full ball, outside off. Jos Buttler prods froward and creams his drive through extra cover for another four.
FOUR! Jos Buttler and England are up and running in style! Another pitched-up delivery, outswinger, outside off. Jos Buttler leans in and drives it through cover for a boundary.
Cameron Green begins with a fuller ball, swinging away, outside off. Jos Buttler drives it towards point.
We are ready for action to get underway! The players are out in the middle. Alex Hales and Jos Buttler will open the batting for England. Cameron Green will begin with the ball. Let's play!
England (Playing XI) - Jos Buttler(C/WK), Alex Hales, Dawid Malan, Ben Stokes, Harry Brook, Moeen Ali, Sam Curran, Chris Woakes, Adil Rashid, Reece Topley, Mark Wood.
Australia (Playing XI) - David Warner, Aaron Finch (C), Mitchell Marsh, Marcus Stoinis, Tim David, Cameron Green, Matthew Wade (WK), Daniel Sams, Nathan Ellis, Kane Richardson, Mitchell Swepson.
TOSS - Australia have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first!

The visitors have recently won a long T20I series against Pakistan with a relatively younger side. But their big guns are back for this crucial series before the mega event. Jos Buttler, who was ruled out of the series against Pakistan is back and will be leading the side. All the eyes though will be on Ben Stokes as he is playing a T20I after more than a year. Which team do you think will carry on with their momentum? We will know soon enough. Stick around for the toss and other updates.
